text: RECAL FOUNDATION invitesapplications for SRI J. RAMAKRISHNAN MEMORIAL Scholarship (initiated by Mr. R.Chandrasekaran– Alumni of 1975-1979 Batch) Four Scholarship Awards of Rs 50,000 each for 2014-2015 Award Eligibility Criteria 1) Open to all students of Computer Science, EEE, ECE and MCA. 2) Academic Record: Minimum CGPA of 6.0. 3) Family income should be less than Rs. 400,000/- per annum. 4) The candidate should not be a recipient of any other major scholarship worth over Rs.10,000 per annum. 5) Preference may be given to an awardee of the immediate previous year, subject to the candidate maintaining a CGPA of 6 and above. 6) Application in the format enclosed shall be submitted to RECAL Secretariat before 7) The selection and the awards are at the full discretion of the selection Committee/RECAL Foundation. 8) RECAL Foundation may seek additional information during the evaluation process that is expected to be completed in 2-3 months.
